SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, MIN(calendar_date) AS d0, MAX(calendar_date) AS d1, MIN(fiscal_week) AS w0, MAX(fiscal_week) AS w1, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_quarter = 3 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS ty_year, 'FY2024/25' AS ly_year, 27 AS first_week, 39 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales,
           COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cs.region
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.stores, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND n.store_id < 900
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND r.store_id < 900
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) store_id, m.mine, c.ctl, ROUND(COALESCE(m.mine,0)-COALESCE(c.ctl,0),2) AS gap,
  (SELECT open_date FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_id=COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) AND is_current) AS open_date,
  (SELECT close_date FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_id=COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) AND is_current) AS close_date
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON m.fiscal_year=c.fiscal_year AND m.store_id=c.store_id
WHERE ABS(COALESCE(m.mine,0)-COALESCE(c.ctl,0)) > 1 OR (SELECT open_date FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_id=COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) AND is_current) IS NOT NULL
   OR (SELECT close_date FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_id=COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) AND is_current) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT 'sales' AS t, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_keys, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id)
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id
LIMIT 16

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c, MIN(sale_date) sd, MIN(store_key) sk FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT d.sd, s.store_id, COUNT(*) AS dup_keys, SUM(c) AS rows_, (SELECT MIN(etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line) AS dummy
FROM d JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = d.sk
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH wk AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_quarter = 3 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')
),
st AS (SELECT store_id, store_name, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900),
sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ns, COUNT(*) AS days
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, st.region, wk.fiscal_year, wk.fiscal_week, COALESCE(s.ns,0) AS ns, s.days
FROM st CROSS JOIN wk LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.store_id = st.store_id AND s.fiscal_year = wk.fiscal_year AND s.fiscal_week = wk.fiscal_week
WHERE COALESCE(s.ns,0) <= 0
ORDER BY 1,4,5
